item.title: CASSA x PECAN+ CTF Creator Competition 🏆
item.description:
Design challenges for PECAN+!

Do you want to put your cybersecurity skills to the test in a different way? RedRoom and CASSA are hosting the CTF Creator Contest, where ECU students can design their own CTF challenges! The best challenges will be featured in PECAN+, a national high school CTF competition.

You only need a ticket if you plan on attending the workshop

item.title: S1: ECU Open Day
item.description:
Open Day

CASSA had the opportunity to meet prospective new students to give them a rundown of the advantages of getting involved with academic clubs like CASSA (and what makes us great) on their academic journey at the ECU Open Day.

We’d like to thank Karina, the ECU staff, volunteers and school ambassadors for all of their work with making the day a success!

item.title: S1: Careers Fair Day
item.description:
Guild Fair

CASSA was thrilled to have the opportunity to speak with current and future students as well as industry professionals at the ECU careers fair day. We’d like to thank and welcome all of our new members, as well as all of the wonderful industry representatives we had the chance to speak with on the day.
